title: Folding drying-rack task suite
goal: Verify that a complete folding drying rack deploys and returns to its folded home position through one shared scissor-linkage roundtrip.

profiles.title: Whole folding drying rack
profiles.description: The approved whole-machine profile derived from whole_folding_drying_rack_v1.

scenarios.title: Deploy and fold roundtrip
execution_requirements: Execute deployment and folding once as one continuous roundtrip; do not rerun the mechanism separately for each task result.
Measure platform displacement from the authored output body rather than inferring it from actuator travel.
Preserve per-time-step physical collision evidence for the complete roundtrip.

tasks.title: Deploy the drying rack
tasks.goal: Move the rack platform to the approved deployed displacement.

criteria.description: The platform reaches the approved 0.18 m deployment target, with no more than 0.004 m shortfall.

failure_diagnostics.description: The platform did not reach the accepted deployment range.
The scissor linkage stopped before the deployment target was reached.

evidence_obligations: Report the measured platform displacement and the accepted lower bound.
Retain both physical and ideal-reference traces from the shared roundtrip.

tasks.title: Fold the drying rack
tasks.goal: Return the deployed rack to its folded home position.

criteria.description: The platform finishes at the folded home position within 0.004 m.
The roundtrip accumulates 0.36 m of platform travel, allowing 0.004 m numerical shortfall; this is supporting evidence and does not replace the final home-position result.

failure_diagnostics.description: The platform did not finish within the approved folded-home tolerance.
The supporting cumulative-travel measurement was below its accepted range.

evidence_obligations: Report final home-position error independently from cumulative travel.
Do not award a pass from cumulative travel when the final folded position fails.

source_projects.note: The source project supplied certified scissor-lift task evidence; the user approved the explicit final-home tolerance during task-suite review.

approval.basis: The user approved the grouped drying-rack task suite, including 0.004 m deployment shortfall and folded-home tolerances.
